Before reserving, confirm that your vehicle is operational, registered, and insured, then measure it before comparing available vehicle-storage spaces. Review space dimensions, access hours, and location requirements at your selected Atlanta property.

- Keep registration records, insurance documents, keys, and sensitive information with you.

## What Should You Check Before Storing a Car in Atlanta?


Check that your vehicle meets the selected location’s requirements before reserving a vehicle-storage space. Confirm the vehicle’s condition, current documents, dimensions, and access needs.


**Atlanta car storage checklist:**


- Confirm the vehicle is operational.
- Verify current registration and insurance.
- Measure the complete vehicle, including racks, hitches, and mounted accessories.
- Remove trash, food, wet items, and personal belongings.

## Is Drive-Up Storage Useful for Atlanta Car Storage?


[Drive-up storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) can help when you need to load boxes, garage items, tools, furniture, or household supplies in addition to arranging vehicle storage. Drive-up units let you park near a ground-level unit door for easier loading and unloading.


Public Storage has 138 Atlanta-area locations with drive-up access. Compare current drive-up unit availability at your selected property before reserving.


## When Should You Compare Climate-Controlled Storage in Atlanta?


[Climate-controlled storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/climate-controlled-storage) can be useful for household items you want to keep separate from your vehicle, such as furniture, clothing, books, electronics, and boxed décor. It is a storage option for household belongings, not a substitute for confirming available vehicle-storage space.


Public Storage has climate-controlled storage at 87 Atlanta-area locations. Features and unit availability vary by property.
